name: Tágide Festival
tagline: Three nights on the river. Parque Tejo, Lisboa, 11 to 13 June 2027.
description: Tágide is a three-day music festival on the north bank of the Tagus in Lisbon, named after the river nymphs of Camões. Four stages, 57 acts, a campsite under the Vasco da Gama bridge and a city that stays up late. Most of the crowd flies in: Madrid, London, Berlin, Paris and São Paulo are the biggest markets after Lisbon itself. The sixth edition runs 11 to 13 June 2027.

styles.label: After midnight
styles.description: The Armazém at 3am. Techno, house, breaks, the crowd that arrives late and leaves at sunrise.

styles.label: Main stage
styles.description: The headliners, the sing-alongs, the confetti. Pop and hip-hop at the Tejo stage on the river.

styles.label: Roots and seated
styles.description: Songwriters, folk, Americana and fado at the Jardim stage. Blankets on the grass before 10pm.

styles.label: Latin and Afro
styles.description: Brazil, Spain, Nigeria, Angola and Lisbon's own: the acts that make the Ponte stage move.
